_doc: Hand-maintained DECISIONS only (DESIGN §A1). Everything that describes CLI behaviour is DERIVED by measurement and lives in channel_table.json / reinterpret.json / measured_with.json, which regen_check.py regenerates against the pinned binaries and diffs (R3 shape change).
_private_channels_on_doc: OSes whose Run path uses the private-channel planner. Every other OS uses the interim path: C1-resolved bytes on argv + --allow-argv-secret. An OS may be listed ONLY if a CI job on that OS runs the real-binary tests (T2, T3', T7); test_plan.py's os_gate checks the workflows.
_env_name_rule_doc: The CLI's own rule (mnemonic-toolkit env_sentinel.rs is_valid_posix_env_var_name).
_real_binary_test_targets_doc: R2 Nm8: the cargo test targets an OS's CI job must run (with MNEMONIC_BIN set) before that OS may be in private_channels_on.
